translations.web: Yahweh, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill?
translations.bsb: O LORD, who may abide in Your tent? Who may dwell on Your holy mountain?
translations.kjv: LORD, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill?
translations.asv: Jehovah, who shall sojourn in thy tabernacle? Who shall dwell in thy holy hill?
